name: peacock-of-prosperity-reveal-memory-to-field
notes: Peacock of Prosperity (cl1mvb9q96, GeneratedMacroCode.php revealAbilities["cl1mvb9q96:0"] / customDQHandlers["cl1mvb9q96:0:Reveal-1"]): "[Class Bonus][Element Bonus] Whenever you reveal this card from your memory, you may put a card named CARDNAME from your memory onto the field. If you do, draw a card into your memory." IsElementBonusActive() is an unconditional stub returning true (confirmed elsewhere in this codebase, e.g. corhazi-infiltrator-reveal-memory-to-field's notes), so only the [Class Bonus] TAMER condition needs a real champion match (Guo Jia is TAMER). Two copies of Peacock of Prosperity are seeded into memory; Uncover the Plot (targeting yourself) reveals the whole memory zone, firing the reveal-triggered ability for each copy (QueueRevealTriggeredAbility, GameLogic.php). Answering the first copy's MZMAYCHOOSE with the other copy's mzID moves it onto the field; the second copy's own offer is declined. Verified live: a second Peacock of Prosperity object appears on the field (myField-1). Break/restore verified: commenting out the MZMove()/DrawIntoMemory() calls makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus][Element Bonus] Whenever you reveal this card from your memory, you may put a card named Peacock of Prosperity from your memory onto the field. If you do, draw a card into your memory.
